environment.timingScope: Unpaced Node.js simulation. Per-decision inference time excludes rendering, observation construction and engine updates; no dedicated warm-up.

protocol.commandCountDefinition: Actual issueCommand calls, including declined/delayed calls. appliedCommandCount counts enacted assignments/recalls and consumed meals; it is not NPC obedience.
protocol.comparisonLimit: Each rescue comparison changes only the controller for one seed/scenario/difficulty/policy. The same adaptive controller can issue different commands under different policies. No population-level or model-superiority claim.
